verdict.rationale: LegalOS is an immigration case-preparation platform described as using 'AI workflows', so recurring or scheduled workflows are a plausible axis to ask about. However, nothing in the evidence documents scheduling recurring jobs, timed triggers or cron-like automation. The only workflow mentions are guided intake and case preparation, which are one-off case flows rather than recurring schedules, and probes found no API or OpenAPI surface.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
